scope: Read-only identity inventory of the fixed selected existing trained checkpoint and its saved converted/declared artifacts. No download/build/Cargo/conversion/runtime execution. No model review, tier decision, new registration, arithmetic conformance, claim certification, P or native credit success is inferred.

adapter.method: Python transcription of adapter/mod.rs resolve/merge/canonical_json and BLAKE2b-512 domain; integral floats normalized and exponent leading zero removed as serde_json renders 1e-6. No converter invoked.

limitations: No upstream network fetch: revision provenance is checked against retained manifests and local checkpoint hashes, not reauthenticated to live Hub.
Artifact tensor inventory root is compared across metadata, not recomputed from every tensor leaf.
Container header/byte identity and class digest reconstruction do not validate model computation, quantization accuracy or A1 profile support.
Historical native/replay success flags are quoted as old data only; no new native registration, P approval or credit authority.
Whole built-in adapter pack and frontend spec digests are retained pins, not recomputed in this focused inventory.

declaration_distinction.explanation: runtime_pack/verify.rs:512-516 explicitly distinguishes the converted artifact from its declared class: layout and logits scheme change, so file digest and graph root differ. Each stage is compared to its own recorded digest; exported fixture and class digest match the declared stage.
